actual_ELF_and_version_join.DT_NEEDED: Read actual runtime/monitor SONAME/NEEDED/version dependency declarations and bind any genuinely new system dependency to real matching providers before claiming complete closure. Reuse exact existing image/runtime facts; no loader/main execution or proactive dependency census in this prep.
actual_ELF_and_version_join.actual_ihklib_join: The two monitor imports ihklib_device_open(int)->int and ihk_os_get_eventfd(int,int)->int bind exact newly produced b7bc Rust libihk and current declared headers. Reuse its actual library/provider/76roots proof and independent result GO; do not rebuild/replay it.
actual_ELF_and_version_join.new_caller: After a separately reviewed real ihkmond production link, join each actual undefined dynamic caller symbol by name and its exact .gnu.version index to .gnu.version_r file/version requirement; then to the same actual provider SONAME, export and version-definition node. Values need not equal between different ELF objects. No symbol-count-only or metadata-only original acceptance.
actual_ELF_and_version_join.provider: For each of the11 names, record actual dynamic-symbol position/value/size/kind/binding/visibility/defined section from actual selected provider. Require an externally visible callable FUNC/IFUNC definition, not an UND entry or a name found only in a string/ordinary static table.
actual_ELF_and_version_join.unversioned_provider: If actual supported provider has unversioned exports, retain its actual version-table absence/global index and bind the resulting exact linked caller. Do not fabricate a version graph.
actual_ELF_and_version_join.versioned_provider: Read that exact provider dynsym position in provider .gnu.version, then join its numeric index and hidden/default status to actual .gnu.version_d node. Use observed version label and default/compat semantics; do not guess LIBUDEV version labels or treat version spelling alone as closure.

actual_linker_input_join.linker_script_or_different_ELF_case: Use the captured literal developer linker input and real ELF/dependency identities. If it is a linker script or resolves to a different file, derive actual referenced input closure before build admission; no text-to-library guess or silent substitution.
actual_linker_input_join.production_expression: -C link-arg=${LIBUDEV}, DEPENDS ${LIBUDEV}; original ihk top uses find_library(LIBUDEV udev).
actual_linker_input_join.provider_binding: Same actual supported native46d profile or separately trusted exact package artifact only. Existing old HOST libudev1.6.17 is reuse evidence, not a replacement selected provider. Bind actual provider version/NEVRA from saved RPM records, not the OS name or guessed package version.
actual_linker_input_join.symlink_case: Actual unversioned and runtime paths must be bound through real readlink/resolved-path/regular-file/hash/package-owner records. If both resolve to the same ELF, record that exact identity; never infer it from shared basename.
actual_linker_input_join.unknown_until_actual_data: Header hash, selected link/runtime hashes, actual library version, SONAME, exported version labels and any new DT_NEEDED dependencies are deliberately unasserted. Pending fixed-input metadata operation supplies them; missing inputs trigger exact trusted package preparation, not a broad inventory.
